marie (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize pilot eligibility & scoring for the Optimize Advisor alpha. Looking for a short rubric we can run against customers who've asked for batching/caching/quant recs + eval alerts. Timeline: pilot kickoff 4/6.

alex (prodeng): +1. Suggested fields: traffic profile (p95 qps), cost per request, seq len distribution, models used, infra restrictions. Maybe a 0-3 score each.

jamal (data-science): Agreed. Add "eval maturity" — do they have labeled evals or synthetic prompts? critical for eval-triggered alerts.

olivia (solutions): From sales: prioritize customers with demo-ready apps and cross-functional PMs. Also ones comfortable sharing small prompt sets.

dmitri (eng): Tech constraints: prefer customers on Dedicated or VPC. Private onprem is tougher for alpha. Also flag heavy streaming workloads.

marie (PM): Proposed quick rubric (0-3 each): traffic, token-cost sensitivity, eval-maturity, infra-compat, urgency. Total >=10 => high priority. Thoughts?

jamal (data-science): I can run heuristic scoring on top 30 customers. Will need CSV: id,qps,avg_seq,p95_seq,model,infra,has_eval,pm_owner

olivia (solutions): I can collect consent + sample prompts from 6 customers this week.

alex (prodeng): For launch gating: we need 95th percentile latency < 2x baseline for 90% of pilot queries, quant recommendations must not increase error rate > 2% on eval set, alerts must have <1 false alarm per 1k checks. Reasonable?

marie (PM): Good. Add rollback criteria: if quant recommendation causes >5% regression on any core eval, auto-block rollout.

dmitri (eng): Implementation note: Advisor will suggest three quant profiles: safe, balanced, aggressive. We'll include expected token savings estimate and risk band.

jamal (data-science): Need to define "error rate" metric per-customer — we'll standardize to task-specific micro-F1 or BLEU depending. I'll draft mapping.

olivia (solutions): Sales ask: a short one-pager checklist for customers: sample prompt export, lat/throughput numbers, eval set, contact person. I'll draft.

marie (PM): Action items: jamal run scores by EOD Thu (2009876560), olivia collect samples from at least 4 customers by Fri, dmitri prototype profile outputs next week. I'll own pilot invite list. @everyone please react with :thumbsup: if aligned.

alex (prodeng): quick note — jamal, when you run scores, please include a "expected ROI" field: estimate monthly token savings at balanced profile. Sales will love that number.

jamal (data-science): Copy. I'll attach a small sample output format:
```
customer_id,total_qps,avg_seq,p95_seq,model,infra,has_eval,score,expected_monthly_token_savings_usd
cust_123,2.4,120,512,redwood-13b,dedicated,true,11,420
```

marie (PM): Perfect. If we can get that sample by Thu afternoon we can start invites next week. Keeping scope tight for alpha: no on-prem pilots, no streaming-heavy customers, limit to 8 customers.

olivia (solutions): noted — will filter for those constraints.

marie (PM): Thanks team. I'll circulate a one-pager and the pilot invite template after this thread.
